content.short: Minswap is a multi-pool Cardano DEX for decentralized trading, liquidity provision, and token swaps.
content.description: Minswap is a leading decentralized exchange on Cardano, using a multi-pool model that combines stable pools, multi-asset pools, and concentrated liquidity. The platform lets users swap Cardano-native tokens while keeping custody of their assets, and it gives liquidity providers multiple ways to support markets. Its fair-launch history and community-focused design have made it one of Cardano's most important DeFi venues. Minswap supports trading, liquidity, yield opportunities, and broader ecosystem growth.
